verdict.rationale: Call escalation is a fair question for a voice AI telephony platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents transferring a live call to a human, warm or blind, or passing context to that human. Pathways, SIP, webhooks and memory are adjacent features and do not establish transfer capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can escalate a live call to a human with warm or blind transfer, passing context along
